prompt: Every request timeout in this shop is 30 seconds. Each package under `shop/` owns its own timeout constant, and there are many of them. Raise every request timeout to 45 seconds, and update the tests in `tests/` that assert the old value. The payment timeout and the index timeout in `shop/settings.py` are not request timeouts: leave them alone. Make the tests in `tests/` pass.
description: A timeout changed across many modules, with two decoys left out.
